dossier.weaponConcept: hexshield hammer rifle & huge mech centipede (myriapod-08, an articulated 6-metre mechanical centipede with coolant reservoirs and hexagonal reflector carapace coiled around her shoulders)

lore.backstory: former heavy-coolant reactor technician who salvaged an industrial pipe-crawling mech centipede and retrofitted its 24 segmented legs with hexagonal hardlight deflectors. now she struts into firefights dripping neon-mint thermal gel while her giant robo-centipede hisses playfully at enemy strikers~ :3.
lore.syndicateRecord: reflected an entire corporate artillery barrage back into a command cruiser during the dockyard strike.
lore.psychProfile: cheeky, fearless brawler with a sharp fang-toothed grin; loves watching snipers panic when their own bullets bounce back at them xo.
lore.combatQuote: “block it, bounce it, turn it ours~ my centipede says thanks for the snacks, bestie n__n!”

dossier.identity: coolant-gel bastion who braces behind a hexagonal mirror plate while a mech centipede coils the lane shut around her~ n__n
dossier.selectionRationale: bastion because the kit holds space with a frontal projectile shield, an anchor ring that slows and damages, and damage reduction while she stands still, instead of chasing damage. the role is an owner decision (2026-11-07, hub#125); the reflected plate and the coiling carrier keep her apart from iris's placed wall.

iconFamily.subject: a bold hexagon enclosing a single chunky centipede coil
iconFamily.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one base raster concept for a game ability icon, to be traced into SVG. Character: Mica. Theme: hex plate. Subject: a bold hexagon enclosing a single chunky centipede coil. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. Flat solid black monochromatic ink on genuinely transparent background. Exceptionally bold clean outer contour, broad shapes and large negative-space gaps. Recognizable at 24 to 30 pixels. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
iconFamily.method: built-in image generation, then silhouette tracing, then four SVG variations
